boards.name: Novoresume
boards.notes: Job-seeker resume builder rather than an employer job board. Footer gives a Copenhagen address and an ApS company name; no parent company stated. Pricing page covers job-seeker plans only.

boards.name: StudentJob FR
boards.notes: Page is in French. States employers can post offers for free; no prices shown. Footer names StudentJob International as a YoungCapital subsidiary. No language switcher or API found.

sources.title: Footer
sources.quote: StudentJob International est une filiale de YoungCapital

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Postez une offre d'emploi gratuitement sur StudentJob dès aujourd'hui

boards.name: Ticjob
boards.notes: Language switcher lists esp, cat and eng. No headquarters, owner or employer pricing stated. The Fundacion Telefonica line describes a partnership, not ownership. About and legal pages guessed by URL returned 404.

boards.name: Happy Monday
boards.notes: Developer page links a job feed and API v4 documentation. API key or access requirements are not stated; other integration requests go by email to the product team. Prices not shown.

sources.title: Developer page
sources.quote: рекомендуємо дивитися документацію по актуальному API Happy Monday.

boards.name: freelancermap
boards.notes: Homepage says publishing a project is free and lists 0% commission fees. Footer gives a Nuremberg company location. No languages, parent, API or partner information found.

boards.name: Banco Nacional de Empregos
boards.business_model: free employer sign-up; paid plans exist (prices not shown)
boards.notes: Employer sign-up is free and plan selection is offered, with no prices shown. Partner page offers BNE job ads for partner sites and an XML feed, with contact at parcerias@bne.com.br. No API found on the pages read. Service is described as Brazil-wide; headquarters not stated.

sources.title: Partner page
sources.quote: Receba nossas vagas em XML para publicar no seu site.

reviews.name: Novoresume
reviews.note: Homepage and pricing page read; footer gives a Copenhagen address and language options; pricing covers job seekers only.

reviews.name: Trampos
